C-SAFE-GPU-OWNER.Name: Prove GPU ownership before loading the local safety reviewer
C-SAFE-GPU-OWNER.Summary: The canonical preflight counts active engines but does not know which engine a caller plans to start. Before any Ollama chat request, prove either an empty GPU slot or the already-loaded expected qwen3:4b; block another engine or another loaded Ollama model.
C-SAFE-GPU-OWNER.ApprovalBasis: Owner requires local-model review before every commit/push; the supplied AGENTS.md and canonical local-AI protocol require one inference engine and one loaded model.

Goals.Goal: Prevent loading the reviewer into a GPU slot owned by another engine/model, with no automatic unload, cloud fallback or weakened preflight.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep canonical preflight, fixed loopback endpoints, no redirects/proxies, serial review and exact candidate recheck. Unavailable or ambiguous ownership fails closed.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No engine shutdown, host protocol modification or product behavior/release change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Empty-slot and expected-model states pass; another engine/model, multiple models, malformed state or failed metadata request blocks before chat.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-064/V-M-064 local review preflight and tests.
